title: DepthShift
description: Describes parameters used to shift and apply modified depth values for a sample/specimen, well log, or other data, based on a data record that is referenced as trusted source for depth.

WellboreID.title: Wellbore ID
WellboreID.description: Identifies the wellbore to which the core and the relevant log belong, which were used for the depth-shift.

VerticalReferenceRecordID.title: Vertical Reference Record ID
VerticalReferenceRecordID.description: Identifies the data record that was referenced as the basis for creating this depth shift. Often this identifies a WellLog record with a wireline gamma ray curve.

VerticalReferenceRecordCurveIDs.title: Vertical Reference Record Curve IDs
VerticalReferenceRecordCurveIDs.description: If VerticalReferenceRecordID identifies a well log, this identifies one or more CurveIDs within that WellLog record that define the log curve(s) used to create this depth shift. Usually this identifies a wireline gamma ray curve.

DepthShiftTypeID.title: Depth Shift Type ID
DepthShiftTypeID.description: Identifies the type of depth shift (e.g., core-to-log, log-to-log, seismic time-to-depth, logging-elapsed time-to-depth).

ShiftedSamplingDomainTypeID.title: Shifted Sampling Domain Type ID
ShiftedSamplingDomainTypeID.description: Identifies the original sampling domain (e.g,, time, depth) of target sample/specimen being shifted. This is only to be used when depth-shifting samples, not well logs.

DepthShiftedSamples.title: Depth Shifted Samples
DepthShiftedSamples.description: Identifies the samples/specimens to shift as well as the intended usage of the depth shift with the identified samples. This is only to be used when depth-shifting samples, not well logs.

items.title: Depth Shifted Sample
items.description: Defines the relationship between this depth shift to a sample/specimen (e.g., rock or fluid) as well as the intended usage of the depth shift with the identified sample.

SampleID.title: Sample ID
SampleID.description: Identifies the sample/specimen (e.g., core) to which this depth shift applies.

CanDepthShiftBeAppliedToChildSamples.title: Can Depth Shift Be Applied To Child Samples
CanDepthShiftBeAppliedToChildSamples.description: Indicates whether the author of this depth shift intends for it to be applied to all rock samples that are subsampled from the specified SampleID. This could be used as a trigger for an application to find all child samples and apply this depth shift to those.

CanDepthShiftBeAppliedToSiblingSamples.title: Can Depth Shift Be Applied To Sibling Samples
CanDepthShiftBeAppliedToSiblingSamples.description: Indicates whether the author of this depth shift intends for it to be applied to all samples/specimens that were subsampled from the same parent sample (e.g., other core plugs taken from the same slab, but for which a depth shift data record is not explicitly generated). This could be used as a trigger for an application to find all sibling samples and apply this depth shift.

AuthorID.title: Author ID
AuthorID.description: Identifies the geoscientist, engineer, or analyst who created this depth shift.

Remarks.title: Remarks
Remarks.description: Free text remarks about this data
